title: AI Sticker Generator
tagline: A physical keepsake, generated with AI.
summary: An interactive sticker creator combining image generation and selfie editing with a guided React experience.
challenge: Turn a generative image workflow into a clear, usable product experience.
process: Built the guided creation flow and its loading, error and result states in React.
Built a Node.js/Express API that handles OpenAI image generation and edits, Supabase storage and n8n workflow webhooks.
decisions: Kept the creation flow visible and step by step so users understand what the AI is doing.
Separated image generation and storage behind a server API.
outcomes: A working public demo is available.
